purpose: Raw-only extra live game state. Never part of the policy observation and never a dependency of the core reader.

format.size: fixed 1 MiB (MAX_BLOCK); the header says how many bytes are meaningful
format.concurrency: single writer, many readers, no locks: seq is ODD while the body is being written and EVEN when it is complete (same protocol as the core block)

fields.name: total_bytes
fields.note: 32 + sum(record bytes); ignore the rest of the 1 MiB

fields.name: flags
fields.note: bit0 live match, bit1 a getter was decoded live

fields.name: verified
fields.note: 1 = the offset was proven by disassembly and the value passed its sanity check this frame

fields.name: index
fields.note: 0 global, 1 = fighter entry 0/P1, 2 = entry 1/P2, 3+ = battle-object slot

format.reader: tools/mem/extra_state.py: unpack_block()/read_block() parse and validate magic/version/count/total/padding

bases.guest_absolute_constants: debug_mode.c uses 0x7100000000-relative constants; extra_state._g() maps them onto the live base

module_table.note: accessor-relative pointers, proven by the first instruction of each lua_bind *_impl thunk: ldr x0,[x0,#N] followed by vtable dispatch

vtable_convention.note: the live module's first qword is its vtable; entries are guest-absolute function pointers. The lua_bind thunk loads vtable[byte_offset/8]. The observed ShieldModule vtable was 0x7104f71a90 and every entry was a guest-image text pointer (0x71004c....).
vtable_convention.dynamic_decode: extra_state.decode_getter() reads the concrete getter's first instructions at run time and decodes ldr/ldrb/ldrsh/ldr s/q, ldr x0,[x0,#imm] and add x0,x0,#imm; it only accepts a load whose next instruction is ret. Every successful decode is evidence for that field in this build.

ShieldModule__is_shield_internal.asm: ldrb w8,[x0,#127]; cbz w8,..; mov w0,wzr; ret; ... ldr x8,[x0,#24]; mov w9,#0x34; smaddl x8,w2,w9,x8; ldr x9,[x0,#40]; ldrsh w8,[x8,#4]; add w8,w8,w1; mov w10,#0x50; smaddl x8,w8,w10,x9; ldr w8,[x8,#64]; cset w0,ne
ShieldModule__is_shield_internal.conclusion: module+0x7F = no-shield flag; part array at module+0x18, stride 0x34; node array at module+0x28, stride 0x50; node+0x40 != 0 marks the part shielding. Published as f.shield.likely (proxy, verified=false).

ShieldModule__get_part_size.asm: ldr x8,[x0,#24]; mov w9,#0x34; smaddl x8,w1,w9,x8; ldrsh w0,[x8,#6]; ret
ShieldModule__get_part_size.conclusion: part array = *(module+0x18), stride 0x34; size = i16 at part+0x06

ShieldModule__get_lr.asm: ldr x8,[x0,#24]; smaddl x8,w1,0x34,x8; ldr s0,[x8,#16]; ret

ShieldModule__get_life_mul.note: life_mul is a multiplier, not the shield HP; no lua_bind getter exposes an absolute shield HP

ShieldModule__get_attack_limit.asm: ldr s0,[x8,#32]; ldr s1,[x0,#128]; fmul s0,s0,s1; ret

ShieldModule__set_size.asm: ldr x8,[x0,#24]; smaddl x8,w2,0x34,x8; ldr x9,[x0,#40]; ldrsh w8,[x8,#4]; add w8,w8,w1; mov w10,#0x50; smaddl x8,w8,w10,x9; str s0,[x8,#32]; ret

ShieldModule__get_center_pos.asm: ldr x8,[x0,#24]; ... ldrsw x8,[part]; ldr x9,[x0,#80]; mov w10,#0x2d0; madd x8,x8,w10,x9; add x8,x8,w1<<3; ldr x0,[x8,#48]; ldr x8,[x0]; ldr x8,[x8,#32]; blr x8; ldr q0,[x0]; ret
ShieldModule__get_center_pos.conclusion: slot node = *(module+0x50) + 0x2D0*part[0].i32; node+0x30 = position object; vtable[4] returns its vector

ShieldModule__set_hit_stop_mul.conclusion: module+0x84 = hit-stop multiplier (not the current hitlag)

DamageModule__damage.asm: ldr x8,[x0,#24]; mov w9,#0x1c0; smull x9,w1,w9; ldr s0,[x8,x9]; ret
DamageModule__damage.conclusion: hit record array = *(module+0x18), stride 0x1C0; damage f32 at +0x00

DamageModule__reaction.asm: ldr x8,[x0,#24]; smaddl x8,w1,0x1c0,x8; ldr s0,[x8,#16]; ret

DamageModule__is_damage_lock.conclusion: slot 75 (beyond the 64-entry prefix of the first live dump); extra_state decodes the live getter

StopModule__get_hit_stop_real_frame.conclusion: the engine's real hitlag length (hit-stop frames), published as f.stop.hit_stop_frame after live decoding

KineticModule__get_sum_speed_x.conclusion: vx is the x component of the vector returned by vtable[24]

KineticModule__get_sum_speed.asm: ldrb w8,[x0,#444]; ldr x21,[x0,#32]; loop: madd x8,i,#0x18,module; ldr w9,[x8,#0x3c]; tst w9,mask; ldr x0,[x8,#0x30]; ldrb w8,[x0,#0x30]; blr vtable[4]; add vectors
KineticModule__get_sum_speed.conclusion: count at module+0x20; entries at module+0x30 stride 0x18; entry+0 object, entry+0xC flag mask; object+0x30 enabled; object vtable[4] returns &velocity. extra_state replicates the sum for mask=all (get_sum_speed(-1)).

WorkModule__is_flag.conclusion: kind array = module+0x18; kind+0x30 = u32 flags; flag id decodes kind=(id>>24)&0xF, word=(id>>5)&0x7FFFF, bit=id&0x1F

WorkModule__is_enable_transition_term.asm_lua_bind: ldr x9,[x0,#40]; and w8,w1,#0xffffff; ldrb w10,[x9,x8]; ...
WorkModule__is_enable_transition_term.conclusion: terms = *(module+0x28), one byte per term; enabled = 0 if b&0x38 else ((b>>2)&1) if b&2 else (b&1)

WorkModule__kind0_arrays.conclusion: int array = *(kind0+0x20) (B's jumps_left evidence), float array = *(kind0+0x10) (get_float dispatch), flags = *(kind0+0x30) (is_flag)

FighterManager__get_fighter_information.thunk: 0x2140fc0: ldr x8,[x0]; add x8,x8,index<<3; ldr x8,[x8,#32]; add x0,x8,#0xF0
FighterManager__get_fighter_information.conclusion: entry+0xF0 is the FighterInformation object; entry+0xF8 is object+8 = its data record

FighterInformation__dead_count.conclusion: u32 dead[3] at record+0xCC/+0xD0/+0xD4 (0xD4 is also the per-type total)

FighterInformation__get_log_int.thunk: 0x20c9fa0: ldr x8,[x0,#8]; mov w9,#0x11b0; smaddl x8,w3,w9,x8; add x8,x8,w1<<3; ldr x8,[x8,#5600]; ldr w0,[x8,w2<<2]
FighterInformation__get_log_int.conclusion: log type<3: record + 0x11B0*type + 8*index + 0x15E0 -> pointer to an int array; field index2 selects the u32. Published raw only (meaning not decoded).

BattleObjectManager__is_active_find_batt.resolver: 0x3ac560: ldr x8,[0x52b7548]; pools = manager+8*k; pool+0x18 count, pool+8 array; strides [0xF940,0x3C30,0x60C0,0x300,0x2B0]; slot+8 = u32 object id; slot+0x3A byte > 3
BattleObjectManager__is_active_find_batt.conclusion: enumeration is a read-only pointer walk; the entry layout beyond +0x3A and +0x20 is not fully decoded yet (published raw)

BattleObjectManager__singleton.note: the singleton cell exists; the pool manager above is the one the lua_bind resolver uses (0x52b7548). Both are published.

StageManager.chain: cell -> object -> [object] = impl; impl+0x17C = stage id/index; impl+0x110 + 8*i = stage object pointers (is_discretion_final_enabled reads impl+0x110+8*index and vtable[148])
StageManager.conclusion: stage id matches B's independent chain; stage objects are published raw (geometry not decoded)

fields.+0x00: u8 melee mode (debug: 1 for a Local Wireless room match, 0 local versus)
fields.+0x420: u32 stage id (debug mode prints it)

match_block.note: match timer and a real game frame counter are not decoded yet

camera.conclusion: published as g.camera.*; the bounds agree with B's live blast zones

records.naming: g.* global; f.* per fighter with index 1=P1/entry0, 2=P2/entry1; bom.obj.* with index = object slot
records.verified_meaning: 1 = offset proven by the disassembly above AND the read passed a type/range check; 0 = raw/derived/proxy

shield_hp.note: the game exposes no absolute shield HP getter; life_mul is a multiplier. part+0x06 is the shield part size, not HP. The raw 0x34-byte part and 0x50-byte node blobs are published so the HP-like field can be identified later (a shield must be active to correlate).

damage_lock_paralyze_critical.note: slots 75/85/91 are past the 64-entry prefix of the first live vtable dump; extra_state decodes the concrete getter at run time and publishes the field only if the decode succeeds.

ground_cliff_id.note: can_entry_cliff/is_attach_cliff are decoded; a numeric cliff id would need can_entry_cliff_hang_data (0x2029bd0) whose return is a hang-data struct, not decoded.

distance_to_floor.note: f.ground.floor_y uses the vector returned by get_center_pos; a true distance requires the ground contact point (get_touch_pos needs a touch id) and is not yet proven.

battle_object_full_layout.note: pools/count/array/stride/id are proven from 0x3ac560; entry+0x20 is used as the accessor only when it maps and the module table reads back; owner/category/entry_id are not decoded. Raw 0x60 bytes are published.

match_timer_stage_geometry.note: rule kind/stock/item/stage id are decoded; the match timer, platform list and RNG-driven frame count are not. The camera bounds/range/pos/target are published as the stage geometry proxy.

game_frame_counter.note: the core block's game_frame is the reader's own frame count; no guest-side monotonic frame counter has been identified yet.

live_validation.method: tools/mem/game_session.py run --owner F --no-launch --no-reader -- python3 tools/mem/extra_state.py --no-shm --print, plus tools/mem/test_extra.py SSBU_EXTRA_LIVE=1
live_validation.note: see FINDINGS_EXTRA.md for the observed values and the verified/unknown split
